comment: Template for AstroPowerBox ESP32 pin configuration

I2C._note: I2C bus for communicating with sensors and ADCs

SPI._note: Optional SPI bus for SD card or other peripherals

pwm_outputs.name: PWM0
pwm_outputs._note: PWM output with thermistor feedback for temperature control

pwm_outputs.name: PWM2
pwm_outputs._note: No thermistor: simple PWM output (e.g., fan, relay)

power_delivery._note: USB Power Delivery controller configuration pins (optional)

notes: pin: GPIO pin number (0-39 typical for ESP32)
thermistor_pin: Analog pin for temperature sensor (-1 = not available)
type: 'Heater' = PWM with temperature feedback, 'Output' = simple PWM
See pinout_esp32_wroom_v1.json, pinout_esp32_lolin_c3_mini.json, pinout_esp32_lolin_s2_mini.json for working examples
Adapt pin numbers based on your board's datasheet and available GPIO
